description: ${~ at the start of a heredoc line removes the previous line's trailing spaces and newline
notes: The spec says strip markers remove spaces, "interpreted as per Unicode's definition", without saying which definition it means. The tab U+0009 and line feed U+000A have the White_Space property but are not space separators (category Zs), and hclsyntax/spec.md says newline sequences are not whitespace. Stripping them is hashicorp/hcl's reading: parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go trims with Go's unicode.IsSpace, which follows the White_Space property.
